displayIdentity.body: Watchfulness, love, and Stephanas’s household. Watch! Stand firm in the faith! Be courageous! Be strong! For they refreshed my spirit and yours. Therefore acknowledge those who are like that.
displayIdentity.title: Watchfulness, love, and Stephanas’s household
